title: 读图
summary: 图画好之后，这一手是读数、过滤还是改窗口。选图种是另一问；看板层递也是另一问。
summaryEn: After the chart is drawn, this gesture is a readout, a filter, or a window change. Picking the mark is a different question; so is drilling a board.
asks: 图上这一手是读数、过滤，还是改窗口？
asksEn: Is this gesture on the chart a readout, a filter, or a window change?

links.whenEn: a readout gesture is not picking the mark

links.when: 图内换层不是看板从结果往下钻
links.whenEn: changing path on a chart is not drilling a board from the result

links.when: 最近邻吸附是读点，不是视线落到格子
links.whenEn: nearest-index snap is reading a point, not gaze landing on a cell
